revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, looking at a paved campus walkway beside a building. Slightly distant oblique view, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Scene includes benches, planted edges, painted loading-bay concrete, and a safety rail. Moderate backlight with usable foreground fill, restrained contrast, ordinary unedited surveillance-camera realism. Main subject: a tall broad-built adult wearing a reflective work vest over neutral clothing with muted orange workwear accents, sitting on the floor with pelvis on the ground, legs extended forward, back lightly supported by posture rather than lying flat, clearly visible. Include a distant worker-shaped silhouette that is not the subject.
